products.name: Semi-Automatic Bottle Capper for Metal Caps
products.description:
Get more productivity with these effective and effortless semi-automatic cappers securely attach aluminum caps onto glass, PP, PE, PET and/or metal bottles.  This extremely easy operation requires minimal operator training. Take advantage of the reduced risk of leakage, product contamination, and evaporation. Improve your product’s uniformity, and appearance.

The capping operation is extremely simple: Inserting the bottle, with the cap already in position, into the capper’s container base. The capper lifts the container into the capping head/forming wheel, where the cap is pressed onto the bottle and four threading rollers shape the perimeter of the cap. At that point the bottle is capped. The operator can now retrieve the finished bottle to repeat the process with a new one. Can be us used with a variety of applications including Beverages, Lubricants, Carbonated Drinks, Wine, Spirits, Essences, Hot Fill, Pharmaceuticals, Oils, Vinegar, Coffee, Syrups, Seasonings, Marinades, Nutraceuticals, Pet Products, Fertilizers, Additives, etc.

Features:

  • EFFORTLESSLY ATTACH METAL CAPS: For Roll On Pilfer Proof (ROPP) Aluminum Metal Screw Caps
  • REDUCE RISK OF TAMPER: ROPP caps prevent pilferage by the use of an integrated tamper-evident (burglar-proof) bands
  • EASY TO USE: Minimal operator training, with no experience needed.
  • SECURE, CONSISTENT SEALS: Capping Head equipped with four threading rollers

This product is easy to use, and offers extreme versatility of use with four available work modes. It is equipped with an integrated heating mechanism that delivers hot tape to produce a secure bond and foolproof adhesion. Built for fast-paced environments that require increased productivity, efficiency, and carton sealing output, this machine achieves accurate and consistent tape measurements with speed and ease.

Features:

Features:

  • SIMPLE TO USE: Quick and easy sealing process that requires very minimal training.
  • BUILT TO LAST: Constructed with high-quality stainless steel to ensuring longevity and a clean and sanitary environment.
  • AUTOMATED TAKEAWAY CONVEYOR: Once your products are sealed, our motorized takeaway conveyor ensures they are automatically discharged, steaming your workflow.
  • BREAKING CASTERS: Transporting the machine is a breeze with its equipped wheels. Also equipped with adjustable height feet to ensure the machine adapts to your workspace effortlessly.
  • VARIABLE SEALING TIME: Adjust the machine's sealing time according to the type of film being used and achieve a perfect seal time and time again.
  • SIZE-ADJUSTABLE: Mobile product-holding plate and film dispenser allow a better adjustment of the film to the package size.
  • SIMPLE USER INTERFACE: Easy to use control panel comprised of twist knobs for easy machine operation.
  • ADJUSTABLE MOTORIZED CONVEYOR: Tailor the height of your conveyor to seamlessly integrate with shrink tunnels and packaging lines.
  • VERSATILE: Our machine is engineered to seal thermo-sealable products made of different materials and thicknesses, making it the ultimate choice for diverse packaging needs.
  • QUICKER PACKAGING TIMES: Seals approximately 12 packages per minute.
  • PRODUCT BUNDLING: This highly versatile machine can package both individual and collated products, making it an indispensable asset for bundling.
  • PERFORATING ROLLER: Two perforating rollers puncture small holes in the film as it dispenses, allowing trapped air to escape during the shrinking process.
  • INDUSTRIAL QUALITY SEALS: Our sealing machine is built for industrial-grade performance, ensuring that your products are packaged with precision and care.

Simple and highly reliable, this vacuum sealer is proven to provide excellent packaging performance.

Features: 

  • ALL-CLEAR CHAMBER LID: See-through acrylic lid allows you to see inside the chamber to supervise the packaging process.

Powder Conveying & Feeding

products.name: TIJ INKJET CODER
products.description:
This Thermal Inkjet Coder provides a versatile solution for most printing and coding applications. A perfect fit for low-to-medium speed coding applications, it can be used continually or occasionally, and requires none of the harsh chemicals and servicing needed by other inkjet technologies. Its high-resolution capabilities allow for the printing of barcodes, logos, and designs that require precision, which can be uploaded into the system with simplicity and ease. Affordable, easy to install, and highly reliable, this coder is used by a wide variety of industries including food, beverage, snack, pet food, chemicals, pharma, manufacturing, printing, and many others.

Features: 

  • PHOTO EYE SENSORS: Automatically trigger the print cycle when a product is present.
  • SECURE SYSTEM: Multi-level password protection for system access controls.
  • INTELLIGENT SOFTWARE: Capable of printing sequential numbers or counters, so that each item printed has its unique number.
  • CLEAN & LEGIBLE PRINTS: A high-resolution inkjet coding system for precise prints with optimal readability.
  • VERSATILE: Multiple print object capabilities including characters, numbers, barcodes, logos, date/time, counters, etc.
  • EASY TO SET UP: User-friendly HMI with a 7" high-resolution full-color LCD touch screen.
  • HIGHLY CAPABLE: A bidirectional printer (can print from left-to-right or from right-to-left), can be used to print onto a variety of substrates, as well as both flexible and rigid materials. (Please contact your JORES TECHNOLOGIES® supplier for more information).
  • OPTIMIZED INK USAGE: System automatically recognizes ink types, and identifies optimum printing parameters for each ink type.
  • INK LEVEL MEASURING SYSTEM: Keeps user informed of available ink levels.
  • TECHNOLOGICALLY ADVANCED: Compatible with variable data from external sources like MS Excel, MS Access, SQL 200, and others.

products.name: CIJ Automatic Inkjet Coder - LINX 10
products.description:
This CIJ Inkjet Coder is a simple, affordable, and reliable continuous printer, capable of printing onto virtually any substrate. Built for easy setup and changeovers, it can store up to 1000 pre-programmed settings, which may include images of your products for easy identification. This LINX 10 machine is equipped with a line speed sensor that supports integration with pre-existing production lines. If the conveyor speed is modified, it will automatically adjust its print speed according to the speed of your conveyor, eliminating the need to stop production to modify its settings and re-adjust the print position. This CIJ Coder will adjust automatically, at any speed, maintaining the same designated print location.

Features: 

  • RUGGED CONSTRUCTION: Robust build with a stainless-steel enclosure and an IP55 rating, suitable for wash down applications.
  • LINE-SPEED SENSOR: Allows you to modify printing speeds, automatically adjusting to the speed of other machines or production lines.
  • COUNTER-FRIENDLY: Compact and portable, with one of the smallest footprints on the market.
  • PRE-PROGRAMMATION: Capable of storing up to 1000 different pre-programmed settings, including pictures of your product for quick and easy identification.
  • EASY SETUP: An intuitive user experience facilitated through a color touch screen with a unique print selection based on your product images.
  • EASY TO MAINTAIN: Self-service is quick and easy following on-screen instructions, without the need to arrange a service call.
  • RELIABLE PRINTHEAD: One-piece, sealed, and adjustment-free printhead requires minimal cleaning to maintain optimal print quality.

products.name: Thermal Transfer Overprinter for Wide Format Printing
products.description:
Print batch codes, barcodes, ingredient lists, logos, and other product information onto flexible packaging with the TT1000 series of thermal transfer over printers. They feature an air-free motor drive system that eliminates the need for compressed air, and an electronic pressure control that ensures quality and consistency. TTO coders for line-printing are flexible, reliable, and easy to use. This makes them a cost-effective solution for high-output, demanding applications.

 *Final product characteristics vary, and will depend on each specific application. Contact our product specialists to define the right machine configuration for your application.

Features: 

  • COST-EFFECTIVE SOLUTION: Does not require compressed air to function, which significantly reduces costs related to installation and operation.
  • ADVANCED COMPATIBILITY: Supports multiple ribbon widths for use in various applications.
  • BI-DIRECTIONAL STEPPER MOTORS: Uses less ribbon per print without affecting print quality.
  • EASY RIBBON REPLACEMENT: A simple cassette replacement system makes it easy to change print ribbons quickly and easily.
  • EXPANDED CAPACITY: Provides long ribbon storage, boosting production line efficiency and reducing ribbon change intervals.
  • SIMPLE MAINTENANCE: Designed with minimal wear parts that are economical, quick, and easy to change out.
  • QUALITY PRINTS: Maintains a constant printing pressure with an electronic pressure control system to provide consistent, high-quality prints.
  • EASE OF USE: Simple touch screen technology requires minimal training and provides a quick and easy way to add code content.
  • VARIABLE WORK MODE: Users can choose to work intermittently or continuously.
  • ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY: Multi-format support, automatic best before dates, scalable text with rotation, mirroring, inverse printing, counters, and much more.
  • PASSWORD PROTECTION: Secure system enables three levels of password protection.

products.name: Thermal Transfer Overprinter for Standard Format Printing
products.description:
The TT750 series of thermal transfer overprinting machines can be used across a range of industrial applications for printing batch codes, barcodes, ingredient lists, logos, and other product information onto flexible packaging. Designed for maximum convenience, they feature a motor drive system that does not require compressed air for operation. Efficient, reliable, and easy to use, these line-printing TTO coders offer a low cost of ownership and are ideal for ensuring quality, consistency, and error-free printing.

  • MINIMAL MAINTENANCE: Utilizes only a minimal number of replaceable and easy-to-maintain parts. 
  • CONSISTENT QUALITY: Electronic pressure control ensures consistent, high-quality prints by maintaining a constant printing pressure.
  • EASY TO USE: Intuitive touch screen technology needs minimal training and provides a simple way to add code content.
  • VERSATILE: Work mode can be switched between intermittent and continuous use. 
  • HI-TECH SOFTWARE: Supports multiple graphic formats, automatic best before dates, scalable text including rotation, mirroring, inverse printing, etc.
  • SECURE SYSTEM: Features three levels of password protection.

products.name: Thermal Transfer Overprinter for Narrow Format Printing
products.description:
The TT500 series of thermal transfer overprinting machines provides an ideal printing solution onto flexible packaging across a wide variety of industrial applications. It is built for maximum convenience and equipped with an advanced motor drive that enables operation without compressed air. Designed to deliver a low total cost of ownership and increase your production line output, these TTO coders are particularly suitable for printing consistent, error-free best-before dates, batch codes, barcodes, ingredients, logos, and other product information.

 

*Final product characteristics vary, and will depend on each specific application. Contact our product specialists to define the right machine configuration for your application.

Features:

  • COST-FRIENDLY OPERATION: Operates without compressed air, reducing installation and operating costs while maintaining consistent print quality.
  • VERSATILE: Can handle a range of ribbon widths to better meet your application and production line printing needs.

products.name: CSL60 High-Resolution Laser Coding System
products.description:
The LINX CSL60 Laser System is the perfect solution for high-speed production lines that require high-resolution marking on difficult-to-mark materials like glass, rubber, and HDPE. With a powerful four-core processor and 60W laser power, it can print complex messages, including 2D barcodes, QR codes, and logos, without compromising code quality.

This system is IP65 rated, making it suitable for harsh production environments in industries such as beverages, automotive, and extrusion. Its high tube life of 45,000 hours reduces running costs and delays, with service intervals typically twice that of the industry standard. Plus, it doesn't require expensive factory air for cooling.

Features:

  • HIGIH-RESOLUTION MARKING: This Laser System can mark complex codes at a high resolution, making it perfect for high-speed production lines.

  • PRINT ON DIFFICULT MATERIALS: High power 60W laser tube that facilitates coding onto difficult materials like glass, rubber, and HDPE.

  • UNMATCHED DURABILITY: This system has an IP65 rating, capable of withstanding harsh production environments like beverages, automotive, and extrusion.

  • HIGH-SPEED PRINTING: Code up to 70,000 bottles per hour, ensuring your production targets are met efficiently.

  • LOW RUNNING COSTS: With a tube life of 45,000 hours, this system has one of the longest lives on the market, reducing running costs and delays.

  • LONGER SERVICE INTERVALS: The system has service intervals typically twice that of the industry standard, ensuring less downtime and more productivity.

  • NO AIR COOLING NEEDED: This system does not require expensive factory air for cooling, further reducing operating costs.

products.name: CSL30 Laser Coder for Large Areas
products.description:
The LINX CSL30 Laser Coder is the ideal solution for high-speed coding requirements, delivering sharp and clean codes on fast-moving production lines. Its advanced technology allows for easy coding on hard-to-mark materials such as glass and rubber, making it a versatile choice for diverse coding needs. With this coding machine, you won't need to invest in additional equipment or machinery to keep up with your coding requirements. It's designed to adapt to changes in line speed, code complexity, or material types, ensuring your coding needs are always met.

Features:

  • CRISP, CLEAN CODING: Designed to produce high-quality codes on glass and other difficult surfaces, making it ideal for a wide range of applications such as beverage bottles and cosmetic jars.

  • ADVANCED CODING CAPABILITIES: Easy flip, mirror, or curve coding on complex shapes.

  • VERSATILE: Over 20,000 different configurations to meet your coding requirements.

  • LARGE AREA CODING: The LINX CSL30 is designed to handle large area coding and multiple lines of products, making it ideal for a variety of industries such as food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics.

products.name: High Resolution Large Character Case Coder
products.description:
This high-definition printer is an efficient solution for coding cartons with excellent print quality and minimum downtime. This large character case coder prints high-resolution barcodes, logos, and text with a print area of 2.76 inches (H) x 78.7 inches (L). The printer has a print resolution of 180dpi and a print speed of up to 21.65 in/s. The Linx IJ375 large character case coder is suitable for porous and semi-porous surfaces of cardboard cartons, which are commonly used across distribution chains. Printed codes remain legible even after extensive handling and long periods of time.

Features:

  • HI-RESOLUTION PRINTING: Produce high-resolution barcodes, logos, and text with exceptional print quality.
  • NOZZLE PROTECTION SYSTEM: Helps minimize downtime by keeping the printhead in optimal condition.
  • EASY TO USE: Large, user-friendly color touch screen enables you to change the message size and content instantly, without wasting labels and pre-printed boxes.
  • MESSAGE PREVIEW: Reduce errors and material waste by ensuring that the message is correct before starting the printing process.
  • MESS-FREE INK CHANGE: Using canisters is quick and easy, and does not require stopping the printer for ink refills.
  • COMPACT & EASY TO INSTALL: Takes up minimal space, making it perfect for a wide range of production environments.
  • PRINTER CLONING ON USB: Allows you to move printer set-ups between production lines easily.
  • FLEXIBLE FORMATTING: Flexible date/time formats enable you to customize your printing process according to your specific needs.
  • REAL-TIME CLOCK FUNCTIONS: Enable you to keep track of the date and time accurately.
  • AUTO BEST BEFORE DATE CALCULATION & CONCESSION MANAGEMENT: Simplifies the process of managing best before dates.
  • SCALABLE TEXT: Including rotation, mirror, and inverse printing, enabling you to create customized designs with ease.
  • MULTIPLE GRAPHIC FORMATS: Supports multiple graphic formats, giving you more options for creating unique designs.
  • PIGMENTED OIL-BASED INK: Uses pigmented oil-based inks, which are suitable for cardboard, paper, and a wide range of porous materials.

products.name: Tabletop Hot Ink Roll Coder
products.description:
Print batch numbers, prices, expiry dates, and more with a solid ink coder that is compact and easy to use! This machine is adaptable and versatile, so you can adjust the temperature and print position to match your products. Its ink dries instantly when applied to create crisp, smudge-proof prints - making your package look professional and attractive. Don't be fooled by its size - This is a high-speed, high-efficiency machine that will increase greatly the speed and efficiency of your production!

Features: 

  • COUNTER-FRIENDLY: Compact size, ideal for small or crowded workspaces.
  • SMUDGE-PROOF & LASTING PRINTS: Uses solid ink for instant drying and strong adhesion.
  • AUTOMATIC PRODUCT DETECTION: Integrated optical sensor for accurate product detection and print positioning.
  • VISUAL & PRECISE: User-friendly control panel for easy machine operation.
  • ACCURATE COUNTING: Built-in screen display with production batch counter.
  • VERSATILE: Works with products of different sizes, thicknesses, and materials.
  • BUILT TO LAST: Stainless steel body withstands heavy and repetitive use.

products.name: Continuous Inkjet Printer - LINX 8920
products.description:
The LINX 8900 Series is a smart, user-friendly continuous inkjet (CIJ) printer designed to enhance productivity and reduce downtime in modern production environments. With a sleek, stainless-steel enclosure, intuitive touchscreen interface, and powerful features like remote connectivity through Linx PrinterNet, it allows for easy control and monitoring from anywhere. Capable of printing up to six lines of text, logos, or barcodes on a wide range of substrates, it’s ideal for high-speed, 24/7 operations. Maintenance is minimal thanks to long service intervals, easy self-service, and the Linx AutoFlush printhead cleaning system. Its broad ink compatibility, batch printing support, and built-in prompts ensure consistent and accurate coding every time.

Features: 

  • Remote Monitoring: Control and service printers from anywhere using LINX PrinterNet.
  • High-Speed, Multi-Line Printing: Print up to six lines of text, barcodes, or graphics on various surfaces.
  • AutoFlush Technology: Automatic, zero-waste printhead cleaning reduces downtime.
  • Versatile Inks: Wide range of ink types and colors for nearly any application.
  • Batch & Date Coding: Built-in prompts and date freezing make batch printing seamless.
  • Durable Build: IP55-rated stainless steel housing, with IP65 option for harsh environments.

products.name: Black Multi-Purpose Ink for LINX 10 Printer - Pack of 1L
products.description:
Looking for a reliable ink replacement for your LINX 10 coder? This 1 Liter pack of black multi-purpose ink was made by LINX, specifically for the LINX 10 machine! This ink is fast-drying and highly pigmentated, resulting in quality, professional, and long-lasting prints on a wide range of substrates. 

Features: 

  • NON-MEK SOLVENT BASE: The LINX Black Multi-purpose Ink L101 1L Pack uses a non-MEK solvent base, making it a safer and more environmentally friendly option than other solvent-based inks.
  • FAST DRYING: With an incredibly fast drying time of only 1-2 seconds on most substrates, this ink ensures quick and efficient printing and reduced smudging, improving your productivity and product quality.
  • BROAD ADHESION PROFILE: Good adhesion on a wide range of substrates, including packaging materials commonly used in the food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and cosmetics industries like PET, glass, and OPP.
  • LONG SHELF LIFE: You don't have to worry about your ink going bad before you can use it all. This ink has a long shelf life to ensure that you get the most out of your ink.
  • LOW SOLVENT CONSUMPTION: Allows you to reduce your ink usage and save money in the long run.

products.name: Blending Solvent for LINX 10 printer - Pack of 5L
products.description:
Easy and economical to use, in a cartridge-type form-factor, this package includes Five (5), one liter (1 lt) LINX B101 Solvent Cartridges. LINX Original Consumables improve coder reliability, protect machine components, reduce downtime, and safeguard your investment. Used in conjunction with the LINX 10 Printing Coder*, the B101 Blending Solvent is an integral product used to create professional-quality prints.

Features: 

  • ORIGINAL FORMULA: An original LINX premium formulation, for complete compatibility with the LINX 10 Inkjet Printer* and outstanding print quality.
  • PACK OF FIVE: Includes Five (5) Original LINX B-101 Cartridges, each containing one (1) Liter of solvent.
  • EASY TO USE: Cartridge-Type sealed containers for error-free usage, and waste-free handling.

products.name: Cleaning Fluid for LINX 10 Printer - Pack of 1L
products.description:
If you're looking for a reliable and effective cleaning fluid for your LINX 10 coding and printing machine, look no further than this cleaning fluid made specifically by your machine's manufacturer. This specially formulated cleaning solution is designed to remove all kinds of dirt, debris, and ink buildup from your printer's printhead, ensuring top-notch print quality and machine reliability. This cleaning fluid comes in a pack of two bottles, each containing 0.5 liters of powerful cleaning solution. With a total volume of 1 liter, this cleaning fluid is perfect for regular maintenance and cleaning of your LINX 10 printing machine.

Features:

  • SUPERIOR CLEANING POWER: Specially formulated to remove all kinds of dirt, debris, and ink buildup from your LINX 10 printhead.

  • EASY TO USE: Simple and quick maintenance help you stay on top of your machine's condition. 

  • LONG-LASTING PERFORMANCE: With a total volume of 1 liter, the C-LINX-FA9W101/1L cleaning fluid is perfect for regular maintenance and cleaning of your LINX 10 printing machine, ensuring long-lasting performance and reliability.

  • COST-EFFECTIVE: By using this cleaning fluid on a regular basis, you can extend the lifespan of your LINX 10 printing machine and avoid costly repairs or replacements.

products.name: Easi Change Service Kit for LINX 10 Printer
products.description:
As a proud owner of a LINX 10 coding and printing machine, you know the importance of keeping up with maintenance to ensure high-quality prints, maximum efficiency, and machine preservation. Designed specifically to help you maintain your LINX 10 inkjet printer with ease, this service kit will keep your LINX 10 printing machine in top condition. 

Features:

  • QUICK & EASY MAINTENANCE: The LINX EASI-CHANGE Service Kit includes the necessary tools for quick and easy maintenance, ensuring that your LINX 10 printing machine is always running at its best.
  • IMPROVE EFFICIENCY: By keeping your LINX 10 printing machine well-maintained with this service kit, you'll enjoy improved efficiency and prevent interruptions in your production.
  • LONGER LIFESPAN: Regular maintenance with the EASI-CHANGE Service Kit will extend the lifespan of your LINX 10 coder, saving you time and money in the long run.
  • HIGH-QUALITY PRINTS: With a well-maintained printing machine, you'll enjoy high-quality prints with crisp, clear text and images.
  • LIGHTWEIGHT AND COPMPACT: The service kit is compact and lightweight, making it easy to store and transport.

products.name: LINX Maintenance Pack for the LINX 10 CIJ printer 0.75L
products.description:
The LINX Maintenance Pack is a must-have for anyone who owns a LINX 10 Continuous Ink Jet (CIJ) printer. This pack includes high-quality Black Ink, specially designed for the start-up of a new Easi Change Service Kit. With exceptional adhesion and contrast on both porous and non-porous materials, such as paper, card, metal, glass, and plastics, this ink is perfect for most general packaging applications.

Features:

  • OUTSTANDING PERFORMANCE: The LINX Maintenance Pack is an ideal choice for those who want to keep their LINX 10 CIJ printer running smoothly.

  • EXCEPTIONAL ADHESION: This pack comes with Black Ink that has exceptional adhesion on a wide range of surfaces, ensuring that your printing is clear and precise every time.

  • HIGH CONTRAST: Crisp, easy-to-read prints every time. 

  • VERSATILE: The LINX Maintenance Pack can be used on both porous and non-porous materials, making it ideal for most general packaging applications.

products.name: One-Piece Induction Liners for PE/PP – Pack of 500 - 119.5 mm
products.description:
Induction liners are great for tamper resistance, ensure product freshness, and protect against elements and pollutants. This lining consists of four layers of material, including one metallic layer over a thermoplastic layer. When used with a induction sealer, a ultrahigh frequency vibration causes the metal layer to heat up, which in turn melts the thermoplastic layer of the lining causing it to fuse to the top of the container.  Ideally used with typical applications such as Food, Pharmaceuticals, Nutraceuticals, Cosmetics and general applications. Available in multiple sizes for your product needs.

Features:

  • 500 INDUCTION DISKS PER ORDER: 4-Layer induction liner compatible with High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) & Polypropylene (PP) containers.
  • TAMPER RESISTANCE: Induction sealing ensures product freshness and seals in aroma and flavors.
  • CIRCULAR DESIGN: Made in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices, complies with applicable FDA regulations (21 CFR 177.1210) for most food, beverage and pharmaceutical products.

products.name: Centerfold POF Shrink Film – 100 Gauge - 12in (305mm)
products.description:
This stretch film roll can be wrapped around any object, no matter the size or shape, and then shrunken with heat. As it shrinks, it conforms to the shape of your object and seals itself, tightly holding and protecting your product. Featuring a centerfold design, this roll of heat shrinkable film has been pre-folded in half to make your packaging experience easier and more efficient.

Features:

  • PRE-FOLDED DESIGN: Centerfold construction for speed, convenience, ease of use, and an improved product presentation.
  • CAN BE RECYCLED: Reduce your footprint on the earth by choosing packaging materials that can be reused and recycled.
  • TOP CLARITY: Hi-transparency film with a visually appealing glossy finish that will give your products a touch of professionalism and aesthetics.
  • FOOD GRADE MATERIAL: Nontoxic film that can be used to package foods and other delicate goods.
  • FLEXIBLE AND ADAPTABLE: Package oddly shaped objects of all shapes and sizes with ease by using this stretch wrapping film that conforms to your product.
  • TOUGH AND DURABLE: Ideal for shipping, transporting, exhibiting, and selling goods.
  • PRODUCT PROTECTION: Keeps your products protected from many different forms of environmental damage. Tamper-evident wrapping method immediately makes evident any form of theft or product pilferage.
  • PRODUCT BUNDLING: Tightly shrinks around your product, keeping it securely in place. Use this packaging method to bundle several items together for shipping or commercial purposes.
  • LOW SHRINKING TEMPERATURE: Can be used with entry-level machines, like a small heat gun, to efficiently shrink wrap an object.
  • VERSATILE USE: Can be used with automatic, semi-automatic, and manual shrink wrapping machines alike. Ideal for warehouses, packaging stations, retail stores, restaurants, grocery stores, manufacturers, and much more.

Manufactured to precise tolerances with hardened industrial brass for enhanced thermal conductivity, optimal ink transfer properties, and long life.

JORES TECHNOLOGIES® Hot Ink Roll Types create superior quality prints for enhanced readability and print uniformity.

Used with Hot Ink Coders, JORES TECHNOLOGIES® Types print alphanumeric ink characters to directly onto a variety of flexible substrates that may include bags, paper, thin non-corrugated cardboard, or plastics. Versatile and economical, Hot Stamp Coders are most often used to print expiration dates, lot numbers, manufacture dates, package dates, and/or product-specific information directly onto a flexible container (bag). These printers operate in a wide variety of industries such as food, beverage, chemical, pharmaceutical, additives, pet food, nutraceutical, and general manufacturing, among many others.

  • Aging Resistance: Long-lasting performance in both indoor and outdoor applications due to superior resistance to environmental degradation.

  • Plumbing and water systems: Provides a durable seal for applications like faucets, valves, and fittings where resistance to water and steam is critical.
  • Outdoor equipment: Ideal for outdoor sealing applications such as electrical enclosures and irrigation systems due to its resistance to ozone and UV exposure.
  • Automotive applications: Commonly used in cooling systems, brake systems, and other automotive applications involving water, glycol, or brake fluid.
  • HVAC systems: Perfect for seals in heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems, where EPDM’s resistance to high temperatures and steam ensures long-term reliability.

Key Features:

  • Superior water and steam resistance: Delivers reliable sealing performance in applications where exposure to water and steam is common, such as plumbing and HVAC systems.

  • Exceptional weather resistance: EPDM is highly resistant to weathering, ozone, and UV exposure, making it ideal for outdoor applications.
  • Chemical compatibility: Provides good resistance to weak acids, alkalis, and polar fluids like alcohols and glycol-based fluids, making it suitable for use in chemical processing and automotive applications.

  • Inner Diameter (ID): 22mm
  • Outer Diameter (OD): 29mm

Industry Compliance:

  • ISO 3601: This O-ring is manufactured to international standards for O-ring dimensions and materials, ensuring reliability and consistency across a wide range of applications.

  • Resistant to environmental exposure: EPDM’s superior resistance to ozone and UV radiation makes it an excellent choice for outdoor applications where prolonged exposure to the elements is common.

  • Non-reactive to polar fluids: EPDM offers excellent resistance to fluids like glycol, alcohols, and water-based solutions, giving it a wide range of industrial applications.

Limitations:

The EPDM 70 O-Ring 3.5mm CS x 22mm ID is a reliable and durable sealing solution for industries that require excellent resistance to water, steam, and environmental conditions. products.description:
Upgrade your pneumatic systems with our high-quality Polyurethane (PU) Pneumatic Tubing in a sleek blue finish. This versatile tubing, featured in a convenient roll, boasts dimensions of 6mm x 4mm x 5m (16.4ft), providing flexibility and durability for various applications. Crafted from premium polyurethane material, this tubing ensures optimal airflow for pneumatic systems, making it ideal for applications in industrial settings or DIY projects. The contrasting blue color not only adds a professional touch but also aids in easy identification. With a length of 5 meters (16.4 feet), this roll of polyurethane tubing offers ample material for your needs, ensuring a reliable and efficient solution for your pneumatic requirements. Elevate your setup with this dependable and precisely sized tubing designed to meet the demands of your projects.

Polyurethane pneumatic tubing has various applications due to its unique properties. Here are some common uses:

  1. Pneumatic Systems: The primary application of polyurethane pneumatic tubing is in pneumatic systems. It is used to transmit compressed air in a wide range of industries, such as manufacturing, automotive, and robotics.

  2. Automation and Robotics: Polyurethane tubing is often used in automated machinery and robotic systems where flexibility, durability, and lightweight materials are essential for moving parts and tools.

  3. Medical Devices: In medical applications, polyurethane tubing can be found in devices such as air-driven surgical tools, dental equipment, and pneumatic systems used in medical diagnostics.

  4. Instrumentation: It is used in various instrumentation applications where flexibility and resistance to abrasion are crucial. This includes measuring and controlling devices in laboratories and industrial settings.

  5. Packaging Machinery: Polyurethane tubing is used in packaging machines for the movement of pneumatic actuators, grippers, and other components. Its flexibility allows for efficient and precise movements.

  6. Agricultural Equipment: In agricultural machinery, polyurethane tubing is used in pneumatic systems for tasks like seed planting, fertilization, and other automated processes.

  7. Conveying Systems: Polyurethane tubing is employed in conveyor systems, especially those requiring pneumatic control for sorting, packaging, and transportation of goods.

  8. Automotive Industry: Polyurethane tubing is used in pneumatic applications within the automotive industry, such as in air brakes, air suspension systems, and automated assembly lines.

  9. Dust Collection Systems: It is utilized in dust collection systems where flexible tubing is needed to connect various components and allow for movement.

  10. Fluid Transfer: In some cases, polyurethane tubing is used for the transfer of certain fluids where its chemical compatibility and flexibility are suitable.

  11. Sports Equipment: Polyurethane tubing may be used in sports equipment, such as paintball markers, where lightweight and flexible tubing is required for pneumatic systems.

  12. DIY and Home Projects: Polyurethane tubing is sometimes used in DIY projects and home workshops for pneumatic tools and air compressor systems.

When choosing polyurethane pneumatic tubing for a specific application, it's important to consider factors such as flexibility, hardness, temperature resistance, chemical compatibility, and the specific requirements of the intended use.

Polyurethane pneumatic tubing has various applications due to its unique properties. Here are some common uses:

  1. Pneumatic Systems: The primary application of polyurethane pneumatic tubing is in pneumatic systems. It is used to transmit compressed air in a wide range of industries, such as manufacturing, automotive, and robotics.

  2. Automation and Robotics: Polyurethane tubing is often used in automated machinery and robotic systems where flexibility, durability, and lightweight materials are essential for moving parts and tools.

  3. Medical Devices: In medical applications, polyurethane tubing can be found in devices such as air-driven surgical tools, dental equipment, and pneumatic systems used in medical diagnostics.

  4. Instrumentation: It is used in various instrumentation applications where flexibility and resistance to abrasion are crucial. This includes measuring and controlling devices in laboratories and industrial settings.

  5. Packaging Machinery: Polyurethane tubing is used in packaging machines for the movement of pneumatic actuators, grippers, and other components. Its flexibility allows for efficient and precise movements.

  6. Agricultural Equipment: In agricultural machinery, polyurethane tubing is used in pneumatic systems for tasks like seed planting, fertilization, and other automated processes.

  7. Conveying Systems: Polyurethane tubing is employed in conveyor systems, especially those requiring pneumatic control for sorting, packaging, and transportation of goods.

  8. Automotive Industry: Polyurethane tubing is used in pneumatic applications within the automotive industry, such as in air brakes, air suspension systems, and automated assembly lines.

  9. Dust Collection Systems: It is utilized in dust collection systems where flexible tubing is needed to connect various components and allow for movement.

  10. Fluid Transfer: In some cases, polyurethane tubing is used for the transfer of certain fluids where its chemical compatibility and flexibility are suitable.

  11. Sports Equipment: Polyurethane tubing may be used in sports equipment, such as paintball markers, where lightweight and flexible tubing is required for pneumatic systems.

  12. DIY and Home Projects: Polyurethane tubing is sometimes used in DIY projects and home workshops for pneumatic tools and air compressor systems.

When choosing polyurethane pneumatic tubing for a specific application, it's important to consider factors such as flexibility, hardness, temperature resistance, chemical compatibility, and the specific requirements of the intended use.

Polyurethane pneumatic tubing has various applications due to its unique properties. Here are some common uses:

  1. Pneumatic Systems: The primary application of polyurethane pneumatic tubing is in pneumatic systems. It is used to transmit compressed air in a wide range of industries, such as manufacturing, automotive, and robotics.

  2. Automation and Robotics: Polyurethane tubing is often used in automated machinery and robotic systems where flexibility, durability, and lightweight materials are essential for moving parts and tools.

  3. Medical Devices: In medical applications, polyurethane tubing can be found in devices such as air-driven surgical tools, dental equipment, and pneumatic systems used in medical diagnostics.

  4. Instrumentation: It is used in various instrumentation applications where flexibility and resistance to abrasion are crucial. This includes measuring and controlling devices in laboratories and industrial settings.

  5. Packaging Machinery: Polyurethane tubing is used in packaging machines for the movement of pneumatic actuators, grippers, and other components. Its flexibility allows for efficient and precise movements.

  6. Agricultural Equipment: In agricultural machinery, polyurethane tubing is used in pneumatic systems for tasks like seed planting, fertilization, and other automated processes.

  7. Conveying Systems: Polyurethane tubing is employed in conveyor systems, especially those requiring pneumatic control for sorting, packaging, and transportation of goods.

  8. Automotive Industry: Polyurethane tubing is used in pneumatic applications within the automotive industry, such as in air brakes, air suspension systems, and automated assembly lines.

  9. Dust Collection Systems: It is utilized in dust collection systems where flexible tubing is needed to connect various components and allow for movement.

  10. Fluid Transfer: In some cases, polyurethane tubing is used for the transfer of certain fluids where its chemical compatibility and flexibility are suitable.

  11. Sports Equipment: Polyurethane tubing may be used in sports equipment, such as paintball markers, where lightweight and flexible tubing is required for pneumatic systems.

  12. DIY and Home Projects: Polyurethane tubing is sometimes used in DIY projects and home workshops for pneumatic tools and air compressor systems.

When choosing polyurethane pneumatic tubing for a specific application, it's important to consider factors such as flexibility, hardness, temperature resistance, chemical compatibility, and the specific requirements of the intended use.
